area.provenanceText: The Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco is committed to providing accurate provenance information for all objects in its collection. Provenance research is ongoing and records are updated as new information becomes available. If you have information about the provenance of an object in the collection, please contact the museum.
artist.label: Artist
artistSearch.label: Artists
artistSearch.heading: Search artists & makers
artistSearch.intro: Search the constituent index by name, or browse alphabetically. The collection includes over 30,000 named makers: anonymous workshops, cultures, and unattributed objects are recorded separately. Portraits are not held for most constituents.
explore.label: Explore
explore.heading: Explore the collection
explore.intro: Browse curated themes, discover works by period, or let serendipity guide you through 144,000+ works spanning 7,000 years of art history.
explore.discoveryIntro: Not sure where to start? Try one of these:

finds.label: Personal collection
finds.heading: My finds
finds.intro: Save objects as you browse the collection. Your finds are stored in the URL: no account required. Bookmark or share this page to keep your selection.
finds.moreLikeIntro: Suggested objects based on the artists, periods, and media in your saved list.
finds.seedIntro: Pick a saved object as a starting point, choose a direction, and keep following. Every step adds to a journey you can share.
finds.seedPickIntro: Every journey begins with one of your saved finds. Pick the object you want to use as the seed.
finds.seedDiceHeading: We think you might like one of these
finds.seedDiceIntro: Based on what you've picked so far. Choose one to keep going.

edu.label: For educators
edu.heading: Educational resources
edu.intro: Resources for teachers, educators, and school groups. Browse lesson plans, find objects currently on view by gallery, and access age-appropriate content for your students.
edu.galleryIntro: Find objects currently on view in specific galleries: useful for planning school visits and gallery tours.
edu.contentLabelIntro: Object pages include a content source label so educators know whether text is from the current gallery label, a web essay, or another source. This helps teachers trust what they're using for lesson planning.
edu.readingLevelIntro: Verified FAMSF content adapted to age-appropriate reading levels for student audiences. Opt-in for educators: never shown by default.
